name: glintchat
description: GlintChat - 轻量级无数据库 AI 智能对话助手（Vue 3 + TypeScript + TailwindCSS v4 / Express 5 SSE 代理）

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "node scripts/dev.mjs server" "node scripts/dev.mjs client"
scripts.build: node scripts/run.mjs --cwd server tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/run.mjs --cwd client vue-tsc -b && node scripts/run.mjs --cwd client vite build
scripts.build:quick: node scripts/run.mjs --cwd server tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/run.mjs --cwd client vite build
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/run.mjs --cwd server tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node scripts/run.mjs --cwd client vue-tsc -b
